metadata.desc: Snapshot-driven autonomous QQ group agent with tool-only external actions and pluggable context renderers.

authorized_group_ids.description: QQ groups allowed to run the agent
authorized_group_ids.hint: Leave empty to disable autonomous runs. Add QQ group IDs as strings; * enables every group.

renderer.description: Context renderer for newly assigned conversations
renderer.hint: Aggregated Delta Block (Dash-separated) uses one user message wrapped in <group_messages_delta> with --- separators; Aggregated Delta Block (Line-separated) joins structured event lines with newlines; Dedicated User Block per Message creates a separate role=user block for each event; XML Delta Block (Structured Components) uses one <group_messages_delta> with outer group metadata and structured event components.

max_context_tokens.hint: Uses AstrBot Core's token counter. The latest observation block drops its oldest records first when it alone exceeds the budget; older records remain searchable through history tools.

rotation_retention_ratio.hint: When the token budget overflows, oldest complete blocks are removed until usage reaches this fraction. Runtime values are constrained to 0.1-0.9.

max_text_chars.description: Maximum stored text length per message

record_self_messages.description: Record messages sent by the bot account
record_self_messages.hint: Enabled bot echo events can enter later snapshots and start another reasoning cycle.

record_empty_messages.description: Record messages with no text or components
record_empty_messages.hint: Contentless transport events are retained for diagnostics and skipped before model inference.

custom_system_prompt.description: Additional persona or group behavior instructions
